rows.task: Join-end edit after Undo/Redo can silently alter the opposite end
rows.userImpact: A user editing one end after history navigation can change corner geometry at the other end without asking for it. Reselecting before editing refreshes the form, but is only a workaround.
rows.featureOwner: F09 Properties/history lifecycle, with F08 domain verification and F28 adapter coordination; no owner reassigned
rows.proposedBoundedAcceptance: After every history step form values equal current model state; editing B preserves current A and vice versa. Test Allow and cap fields, Undo/Redo, reselect, layout transition, save/reopen and semantic/UI interleave. One edit produces one accurate receipt.
rows.unresolvedDecisions: Exact refresh ordering/root cause needs owner investigation. Do not assume F09 or F28 candidates contain or fix this defect; they were not freshly reproduced here.
rows.originalObservation: After Redo of Start A disallow, raw Settings has a.allow=false but the editable control shows Allow. Changing End B cap to Square then writes a.allow=true. Downloaded IFC confirms both that unintended A change and requested B change.
